title: Yocan Regen Concentrate Vape Device
description:
Description
This Kit Includes
Specifications
The Yocan Regen is the result of refining generations of concentrate vapes into one premium portable vaporizer. With 5 temperature presets and an 1100mAh battery, you will be able to find exactly the perfect hit every time.
Also includes a silicon storage container in the bottom of the device.
Regen Specifications
Heating Style:
Conduction
Heating Coil(s) Available:
Quartz Dual Coil and Quarts Tri Coil
Dimensions:
110 x 19 mm
Battery Capacity:
1100 mAh
Output Voltage:
3V – 4V
Preset Temperatures:
375F / 390F / 405F / 420F / 435F
Regen Kit Includes
1 x Regen
1 x Quad Dual Coil (installed)
1 x Quad Triple Coil
1 x Stainless Steel Dab Tool
1 x Charging Cable
1 x Hanging Ring
1 x Lanyard
1 x User Manual
